children: Tesla (TSLA) moved higher Monday after the Czech Republic granted provisional approval for the automaker's Full Self-Driving system, clearing the way for a rollout in the country.

The decision marks a shift from the country's earlier reservations about the technology. Czech authorities said additional European operating data, experience from other markets, and monitoring measures helped address concerns tied to speed-limit compliance and driver supervision.

Tesla said on X that deployment of the system in the Czech Republic is expected to begin soon. The approval follows a similar authorization by Dutch regulator RDW earlier this year and adds to a growing list of European countries allowing the software under provisional frameworks.

Full Self-Driving is an advanced driver-assistance system that can handle steering, braking, and acceleration while requiring drivers to remain attentive and ready to take control. Tesla has been seeking broader acceptance of the technology across Europe as regulators evaluate its safety and performance.
Tesla shares climbed about 2.7% in recent trading.

title: Tesla Stock Rises After Major Self-Driving Win in Europe
